lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered array of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in near-vertical columns; spot diameter and inter-spot distance increase relative to the posterior vector from the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel luminance serve as axial alignments for the circular clusters, most apparent in the central region of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear feature in the superior flank region showing a high-contrast boundary between a light-reflective upper surface and a shadowed lower concavity.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple slender, high-luminance elongated shapes trailing near the posterior margin of the pectoral fin, consistent with commensal organisms.
